Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a reticulo-nodular pattern predominantly in the right perihilar region and left mid zone (indicated by blue arrows), along with nodular opacities in the left upper zone and adjacent to the left costo-phrenic angle (indicated by the yellow circle). This bilateral, asymmetric distribution involving the mid-to-upper zones and costophrenic angles is consistent with the typical radiographic presentation of pulmonary sarcoidosis.
